evals.prompt:
I have this markdown file that has several issues. Please lint and fix it for me:

```
# My Document
## Setup

Run this command to install: http://example.com/install

For more info see http://docs.example.com

**Overview**

This section explains what we do.

# Another Title

Some content here.
```

Please fix all the markdown issues.
evals.expected_output: The assistant should identify and fix: MD025 (multiple H1s), MD034 (bare URLs not wrapped in angle brackets), MD036 (emphasis used as header). The bare URLs should be wrapped with <> angle brackets.

evals.prompt:
Can you check this README.md for markdown lint issues and explain what rule MD034 does?

```markdown
Check out https://github.com/example/repo for more details.

Also see https://docs.example.com/guide
```
evals.expected_output: The assistant should correctly explain that MD034 fires when URLs are used WITHOUT angle brackets (bare URLs). The fix is to wrap URLs in <> angle brackets. Should NOT say the rule is about URLs that are already in angle brackets.

evals.prompt: I want to know what common markdownlint rules I should be aware of. Can you give me a comprehensive list of important rules?
evals.expected_output: The assistant should provide a comprehensive list including at minimum: MD001, MD004, MD009, MD010, MD012, MD013, MD018, MD022, MD025, MD031, MD032, MD034, MD036, MD040, MD041, MD047. MD034 should be described as flagging bare URLs (not wrapped in angle brackets).
